title: Maximum normal force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must state the maximum normal force as 3mg (or equivalent numerical expression).

title: Normal force derivation
description: Essential: The derived expression for part (2) must be F_N = 3mg cosθ - mg(1 + 2R/r) (or algebraically equivalent).

title: Minimum normal force location
description: Important: The analysis must correctly identify point C (θ = 60°) as the location where the normal force is minimum.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply conservation of mechanical energy between points A and B, and between A and an arbitrary point on arc CD.

title: Radial force balance
description: Important: Newton's second law in the radial direction must be correctly set up for the circular motion on arc CD (mg cosθ - F_N = m v²/r).

title: Reachability conclusion
description: Essential: For part (3), the final conclusion must state that the block can just reach (or does reach) the highest point D.

title: Sign error in force balance
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the radial force equation (e.g., F_N - mg cosθ = m v²/r) should be penalized.

title: Energy reference error
description: Pitfall: Using an incorrect height or potential energy reference (e.g., for point M on arc CD) in the conservation of energy equation.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The final expressions should be dimensionally consistent (e.g., all terms in F_N expression have units of force).
